description: Converts a dog's age (1 to 16 years) into human years using the American Veterinary Medical Association chart (about 15 human years at 1, 24 at 2, then about 4 to 6 per year), and says when dogs are usually considered seniors. For questions like how old a dog is in human years.

language.description: The language the user is writing in, as a language code (e.g. en, de, sv, pt-BR, es-MX, ja, ar). The answer comes back in that language.

months.description: Extra months on top of the years, 0 to 11.

years.description: The dog's age in whole years, 0 to 16.

name: calculate_dog_human_age
title: Dog age in human years
